**Sec. 715** — Bars funds for personnel preparing President's budget appropriations language (Ag/RD/FDA subcommittee jurisdiction) assuming unenacted user fee proposals, unless budget identifies alternative spending reductions before conference convening.

**Sec. 716 (Reprogramming)** — Bars reprogramming/transfer/Economy Act reimbursements (or USDA authorities: §702(b) of 1944 Organic Act, 7 USC 2257; §8 of PL 89-106, 7 USC 2263) that: (1) create new programs; (2) eliminate program/project/activity; (3) increase funds/personnel where denied/restricted; (4) relocate office/employees; (5) reorganize; (6) contract out/privatize — unless Ag/HHS Sec. or CFTC Chairman notifies + gets approval from Appropriations Committees ≥30 days advance. Subsec (b): threshold $500,000 or 10% (lesser) for augmenting/reducing 10%/personnel savings. Subsec (c): approval before new prior-year-absent program. Subsec (d): 30-day notice for: (1) major capital investment changes >$500,000 or 10%; (2) realigning positions to create entity ≥5 personnel; (3) activities not in budget request. Subsec (e): requires written/email confirmation of receipt.

**Sec. 717 (Fees)** — Notwithstanding §310B(g)(5) of Consolidated Farm & Rural Development Act (7 USC 1932(g)(5)), Secretary may assess one-time fee ≤3% of guaranteed principal for B&I loans.

**Sec. 718** — Bars USDA/FDA/CFTC/FCA from transmitting appropriations hearing reports/questions/responses to non-department employees.

**Sec. 719 (Prepackaged news)** — Bars executive branch from producing prepackaged news stories for US broadcast unless clear notification of agency preparation/funding included.

**Sec. 720 (Detail)** — No USDA employee detailed/assigned >60 days/FY unless employing office fully reimbursed.

**Sec. 721 (Spending plan)** — Within 30 days of enactment, Ag Sec./FDA Comm./CFTC Chairman/FCA Chairman submit detail
